questions.question: Find 3/4 of 36 and explain each step.
questions.expected_answer: Divide 36 by 4 to find one quarter: 9. Three quarters is 3 times 9, which is 27.

questions.question: A jacket costs R240 and has 1/4 off. What is the new price?
questions.expected_answer: 1/4 of R240 is R240 divided by 4, which is R60. That is the discount, so the new price is R240 minus R60, which is R180.

questions.question: Which is more: 1/2 of 40 or 1/3 of 90? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: 1/2 of 40 is 20 and 1/3 of 90 is 30, so 1/3 of 90 is more. A smaller fraction of a bigger amount can be more than a bigger fraction of a smaller amount.
